item.title: Celo Integrates Nigeria’s Regulated cNGN Stablecoin
item.summary: Celo has expanded its blockchain ecosystem by integrating cNGN, Nigeria’s first regulated naira-denominated stablecoin, marking a significant step toward advancing digital payments and financial services in one of Africa’s largest economies.
